justification: Both surfaces depict bearded men in strict profile whose beards and back hair are rendered as regimented tiered rows of tight curls beneath a tall patterned headdress, a conventional and fairly specific figure type shared between them. The biggest difference in content is that A shows a multi-figure procession of whole standing bodies in robes with held objects arranged in registers above a rosette band, while B shows only a single isolated head and shoulder with no interaction, ornament band or accompanying figures.
